label: For every y, perfection r and z, if y's having r is received in z, then y has r only to the…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.1-2: for every y, perfection r and z, if y's having r is received in z, then y has r only to the measure of z's capacity. The passage says it of form received in matter and of the esse of a subsistent created form; the extension to every perfection is the analyst's (esse instance: STMT-RECEIVED-ESSE-IS-LIMITED).
